page.overview:
What is Unidentified body temperature regulation power?

A Force power that helped an individual regulate their body temperature was known to Mirialan Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh. She taught the ability to Jedi Knight Indara.

The body temperature regulation power appeared in The Acolyte: Wayseeker, a 2025 novel written by Justina Ireland.
